name: WordCraft

limitations: - OpenGL: AROS One 1.3 has only Mesa's software renderer, so AUTO uses
CPU. GPU uses the software renderer, which works but is several times
slower than CPU.

aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.system: AROS x86_64, mainline ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-06 or later)
aros-x86_64-abiv1-pc.sdk: x86_64 mainline ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - AUTO uses CPU on this system: a program that has opened OpenGL leaves its
log file in use after it ends, and the Shell it ran in stops redirecting
the output of later programs (seen on nightly 2026-11-10). GPU opens
OpenGL all the same.
- OpenGL: with Mesa's software renderer AUTO uses CPU. GPU uses the
software renderer, which works but is slower than CPU. Hardware OpenGL
drivers have not been tested.
- In one test session the system's list of volumes and assigns was
damaged after WordCraft had run; later sessions with the same programs
did not show it and the cause is not known. Keep your documents saved.

aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.system: AROS on Raspberry Pi, AArch64 ABIv1 (nightly 2026-11-06 or later)
aros-aarch64-abiv1-raspi.sdk: Raspberry Pi AArch64 ABIv1 SDK of nightly 2026-11-10
limitations: - OpenGL has not been tested on Pi hardware, so AUTO uses CPU. GPU opens
OpenGL; in an emulator (Mesa's software renderer) it is much slower than
CPU. Save your work before you try GPU.
- Tested in an emulator only, not on a physical Raspberry Pi.
- Changes of the whole window (scrolling, zooming, opening a dialog) redraw
all of it; on slow machines and in emulators these follow with a delay.
- No printing: export to PDF instead. Files dropped on the window are not
opened.
- Chinese, Japanese, Korean and emoji characters are kept in documents but
are shown as boxes: no such font is built in or installed with AROS.
- Paste Special has not been tested on AROS. Keyboard layouts have been
tested with the Polish keymap on ABIv11 only.
- No automatic updates. The MCP server (wordcraft-cli mcp) has been tested
only for its handshake on AROS.
